title: Lakehouse: machine-readable status (System B JSON)
description: Runs `nexus status lakehouse --json` — the machine-readable ClusterStatus over the 16 nodes for scripting/automation.

observe.what: a single JSON ClusterStatus document: 16 members with role + status, leader = the ALIVE spark master, Shards null

whatProves: The --json projection of GetStatusAsync gives a stable machine-readable contract for the lakehouse tier (System B).
